div.head: I Ew 2
div.ab: Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære ðe oðrum rihtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.
Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære þe oðrum ryhtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande; ⁊ ðæt he him geandagode of þam folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.
Item diximus, cuius dignus esset, qui rectum alicui disfortiet uel in bocland uel in folcland; et ut ei adterminetur in folclánd, quando rectum uelit ei facere coram preposito suo.

[Be ðone ðe oþrum rihtes wyrnþ.] [Ld] Eac we cwædon, hwæs se wyrðe wære þe oðrum ryhtes wyrnde aðor oððe on boclande oððe on folclande; ⁊ ðæt he him geandágode of þam folclande, hwonne he him riht worhte beforan ðam gerefan.

Further, we have declared what [penalty] he is liable to, who withholds from another his rights either in 'bookland' or 'folcland'. And with regard to 'folcland' [we have declared] that he [the plaintiff] shall appoint a day when he [the defendant] shall do him justice in the presence of the reeve.

(Von dem, der einem anderen Recht[sgang] weigert. Ld) Auch bestimmten wir, wessen der [Verklagte] schuldig sei, welcher einem anderen Recht[sgang] verweigert, sei es an Urkunden-Grundeigenthum oder an volks[rechtlichem] Grundeigen; und dass für das volks[rechtliche] Grundeigen [Kläg]er ihm einen Termin setze, wann [Verklagt]er ihm vor dem Gerichtsvogte Recht erfülle.

(Of one who refuses another [due process of] law. Ld) We also determined what the [accused] is liable for who refuses another [due process of] law, whether concerning land held by charter or land held by folk-right; and that for folk-land [the plaintiff] should fix him a term on which [the accused] should do him right before the reeve.

note.label: explained by
note.quote: One of Alfred's most important laws was about 'bookland', and it helps to explain what his son said about it (n. 124: Af 41)
